stories.title: Apache HTTP Server patches critical HTTP/2 remote code execution flaw
stories.summary: A critical vulnerability in the HTTP/2 module of Apache HTTP Server could be exploited by an unauthenticated attacker to obtain remote code execution (RCE).

stories.title: Check Point warns of zero-day flaw exploited for root access
stories.summary: Check Point Software has released emergency hotfixes to address a high-severity flaw that hackers have been exploiting to gain root privileges and establish persistence on vulnerable devices since late October.

stories.title: Hackers Exploit New N-central Zero-Day Hours After PoC Publication
stories.summary: Dubbed 4EverAble2Shell, the flaw could allow remote, unauthenticated attackers to execute code with root privileges.

stories.title: Operation Endgame Takes Down Gootloader, CastleRAT and StealC Servers, Seizes 6.4M Stolen Logins
stories.summary: An international police operation took down servers behind Gootloader, CastleRAT and StealC this week. Criminals used the three malware tools to gain access to computers, steal passwords, and launch ransomware attacks. stories.title: New N-able "4EverAble2Shell" zero-day exploited hours after PoC released
stories.summary: Hackers are actively exploiting a newly disclosed N-able N-central zero-day vulnerability dubbed "4EverAble2Shell" to compromise servers and deploy cryptocurrency miners, with researchers reporting at least 21 affected systems, including 19 running the company's latest security update.

stories.title: Apify rotates API tokens, prompts 2FA resets after breach
stories.summary: Apify has rotated critical internal secrets and revoked some third-party OAuth connections after detecting unauthorized access to its internal systems.

stories.title: Nightmare Eclipse Drops Windows Zero-Day Exploit ‘SignDrop’
stories.summary: It abuses CLFS and Windows Defender to trigger arbitrary file creation in the context of the antimalware process.

stories.title: PTC Patches Critical Windchill and FlexPLM Flaw That Could Enable Remote Code Execution
stories.summary: PTC has released patches for a new critical vulnerability impacting Windchill and FlexPLM software that, if successfully exploited, could result in remote code execution.
